_doc: PR-B (2026-05-30) — user-facing strings for the 7-step Curator onboarding wizard. Loaded via TemplateManager.loadJson(ConfigTemplateId.Onboarding). Vocabulary contract: Profile→Provider, Quick→Fast Lookup, Deep→Research, Premium→Use stronger model when needed, Embedding→Knowledge Index, Web Search slot→Web Access, MCP Servers→External tools, Permission mode→Safety. Edit values freely; the wizard falls back to DEFAULT_ONBOARDING_STRINGS in src/ui/view/onboarding/onboardingStrings.ts if any key is missing.

welcome.description: We will look at your environment (RAM, installed Ollama, configured API keys, note language) and your preferences (budget, speed vs quality) to pick a model for Fast Lookup, Research, and the “stronger model when needed” tier. You can accept, edit, or redo at any time.
welcome.manualCta: Skip — I will configure it myself (advanced)

capabilities.title: What Peak can do
capabilities.description: Chat with your vault, search across notes, run analysis, and use Copilot inline on a note.

provider.title: Pick a Provider
provider.description: The setup assistant pulls one starter model from this Provider; the final tier bindings can come from any Provider.

bootstrap.title: Pick a starter model
bootstrap.description: The setup assistant runs once with this model to recommend bindings for each tier. Pick the cheapest viable option — it only runs once.
bootstrap.missingProviderHint: Go back and pick a Provider first.
bootstrap.noLocalModelsHint: No local models found — run `ollama pull qwen3:4b`, then come back.
bootstrap.noCatalogModelsHint: No usable models found for this Provider. Catalog may be out of date.

preferences.title: Two last questions
preferences.description: The setup assistant uses your answers to recommend bindings — not a commitment, you can accept, edit, or redo.

quality.label: Quality first
quality.hint: Use a stronger model when it matters

running.title: Setup assistant is analysing…
running.description: Scanning RAM, Ollama, configured Providers, note language; matching catalog models; building a recommendation with reasoning. Usually 5–15 seconds.
running.bootstrapMissingError: Starter model missing. Go back and pick one.
running.catalogUnavailableError: Model catalog unavailable. Using a rule-based fallback.
running.profileGoneError: Selected Provider no longer exists. Go back and re-pick.

review.title: Recommended setup
review.applyAllFailedNotice: Apply failed: every tier is missing a matching Provider. Add a Provider first.

tierDescriptions.premium: Fallback for the hard or critical moments

editRecommendation.title: Edit tier bindings
editRecommendation.description: Each tier lists catalog models suitable for it. Tap "Done" to return to the recommendation preview.

redoInput.title: Tell the setup assistant what to change
redoInput.description: It will re-recommend based on your feedback.
redoInput.placeholder: For example: the stronger model is too expensive — try Sonnet instead
presets: The stronger model is too expensive — pick something cheaper
Lean more on local models, less on cloud
Fast Lookup is too weak — pick something smarter
Research is too slow — pick something faster

indexReadiness.title: Check your Knowledge Index
indexReadiness.description: Pick an indexing action to continue. (Detailed recommended-action UI lands in the next refresh.)

systemCheck.title: System check
systemCheck.description: Summary of Provider, AI behaviour, Knowledge Index, Web Access, and Safety. (Live readiness rows land in the next refresh.)

readyToTry.title: You are ready to use Peak Assistant
readyToTry.description: Open Chat, search your vault, run AI Analysis, or use Copilot inline. (Launchpad UI lands in the next refresh.)
